It’s an interesting cartridge, but whereas it takes a 5.56x45 parent case, shortens it and necks up to a larger diameter bullet, I went the opposite route and took a .308 parent case and necked down to a smaller .264 bullet.

My reasoning was more case capacity, more powder, high BC and intermediate grain weight bullet (120-140gr) traveling pretty dang fast, but ultimately I chose it because of a preference to the AR10 platform vs the AR15.
